description: This warbird was built from cutting-edge designs that would go on to become General Oh’s flagship in years to come. The Order of Ganmadan needed a flagship of their own, and this heavy-hitting battleship was the perfect solution, though getting their hands on the designs was no easy task. Named after a powerful and dangerous Romulan prophecy, the Admonition promises to bring ruin to those who dare to challenge it.

ship_ability.title: Apex Aegis
ship_ability.description: Increases Apex Barrier by +{value} at the start of combat versus players (does not apply to Stations).
